sources.title: Conservation status and regional habitat priorities for the Orinoco crocodile: Past, present, and future
sources.locator: Abstract; Results; Materials and Methods, data sources and habitat-model thresholds.
sources.scope: Historical literature synthesis and potential-habitat model for Colombia and Venezuela using records through 2015; occurrence inputs included sightings and active nests.
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution License, stated in the article copyright section; the article does not specify a numbered version.
sources.rightsEvidenceLocator: Copyright statement after article citation; Creative Commons Attribution License.
sources.attribution: Balaguera-Reina SA, Espinosa-Blanco AS, Morales-Betancourt MA, Seijas AE, Lasso CA, Antelo R, et al. (2017). Conservation status and regional habitat priorities for the Orinoco crocodile: Past, present, and future. PLoS ONE 12(2):e0172439. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0172439. Claims are paraphrased.

claims.text: The authors reviewed 289 documents published from 1900 to 2015 and compiled 1,334 sighting or active-nest locations; 125 spatially rarefied locations were used for model training. Under the study's higher suitability threshold, 23,621 km2 were estimated as suitable, with 10.8% within protected areas.
claims.scope: Historical Colombia–Venezuela records and a threshold-based habitat model; areas are estimates, not current occupied range.

gaps: No multi-source species dossier is added.
The model does not provide a current census or replace a present-day conservation assessment.
